---
name: verification
description: Verify implementation through tests and validate generated documentation quality.
---

# Verification Skill

## Purpose

Validate both software behavior and documentation quality.

## Code Verification

Run:

- Unit tests
- Integration tests
- Relevant static checks
- Linting where available

## Test Scenarios

Verify:

- Happy path
- Invalid input
- Missing input
- Not Found
- Empty repository
- Missing files
- External/API failure
- Unexpected response

## Documentation Verification

Verify:

- requirements.md exists
- architecture.md exists
- design-review.md exists
- impl-plan.md exists
- Documentation matches implementation
- No placeholder information remains unnecessarily
- No secrets are present
- Requirements are traceable to implementation

## Output

Provide:

### Test Summary

### Passed

### Failed

### Documentation Validation

### Known Issues

### Known Limitations

### Final Recommendation
